g.text: ANTICHOLINERGICS (urinary + confusion + constipation + falls): chlorpheniramine, bladder
antispasmodics, tricyclics, first-gen antihistamines in cold cures — burden ADDS UP.
SEDATIVES: benzodiazepines + 'sleeping tablets' (falls + delirium + dependence) — sleep
hygiene first (M01); antipsychotics for BPSD (stroke/death — specialist only, M03).
NSAIDs chronic (bleed + kidney + HF — PPI + shortest + review); sulfonylureas long-acting
(hypo — prefer safer agents); nitrofurantoin (poor kidney + lung risk); sliding-scale
insulin alone; muscle relaxants; highly anticholinergic antiemetics.
SENSITIVITY UP: brain (sedation/confusion at baby doses), BP (dizzy drops),
bleeding (anticoag + NSAID + falls = triple threat), glucose (hypo unawareness), kidney
(NSAID + diuretic + ACEi = triple whammy — watch creatinine + K+).
PRESCRIBING CASCADES (drug treats drug's side effect): NSAID → HTN → amlodipine →
ankle swelling → furosemide → incontinence → anticholinergic → confusion → antipsychotic…
STOP: ask \"could a DRUG cause this new symptom?\" BEFORE adding (M02 CGA meds domain).
OTC + HERBAL count: NSAIDs, cold cures (anticholinergic!), laxatives, 'blood tonics' (iron),
herbals (bleed + kidney + interactions — ask WITHOUT judgment, document, check).
RULE: every elder drug needs indication + benefit>harm + lowest dose + review date —
\"we've always taken it\" retires here (M04 deprescribing next lesson).
Exam line: \"less water, slower liver, weaker kidney, tender brain — start low, go slow, review all.\"
